BiblicalUsage: Harnepher is named once, as a son of Zophah, in the genealogy of Asher. Chronicles lists him among the sons of Zophah, beside Suah, Beri, and Imrah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogy keeps even the briefest names: Harnepher is counted among his brethren of Asher.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
